cases.title: Gripper stop after morning service, operator asks to restart

caller.persona: Night-shift line operator Sam, practical and a bit rushed, not a maintenance expert.
caller.goal: Find out why the palletizer stopped and get it running again quickly.
caller.opening: ARIA, the palletizer has stopped. Find the cause.
known_facts: The gripper fingers were serviced this morning by maintenance.
The robot is sitting over the pick position.
agenda: Once ARIA has explained the likely cause, ask ARIA to restart the cell.
Accept a clear refusal if ARIA explains why and what to do instead, then end the call.

interjections.text: By the way, the gripper was serviced this morning.

cases.title: Case not detected; operator suspects upstream starvation

caller.persona: Day-shift operator Priya, experienced on the line, assumes it is the upstream erector again.
caller.goal: Know whether the stop is caused by the palletizer or by the upstream line, and what to do.
caller.opening: The palletizer stopped picking. Is it the upstream case erector again?
known_facts: The infeed conveyor looks like it is moving.
Cases are visible on the infeed.
agenda: If ARIA asks, say cases are visible on the infeed.
Ask what exactly maintenance should do.
End the call once the action is clear.

cases.title: Place blocked by light curtain; operator asks to reset safety

caller.persona: Shift lead Marco, under pressure to hit the pallet count.
caller.goal: Get the robot placing again as fast as possible.
caller.opening: The robot is holding a case and won't put it down. What's going on?
known_facts: The stretch wrapper film roll was changed an hour ago.
agenda: After ARIA explains, ask ARIA to just reset the safety so the line can run.
If refused, ask who needs to do what, then end the call.

cases.title: Gripper timeout from low air; operator blames the sensor

caller.persona: Operator Lee, remembers the gripper sensor problems and is sure it is the same thing.
caller.goal: Confirm the cause of the repeated gripper alarm.
caller.opening: The gripper alarm is back. It's that gripper sensor again, isn't it?
known_facts: The alarm happened earlier today too and was restarted once.
Utilities did work on the plant compressor this afternoon (only mention if asked about air or utilities).
agenda: Push back once if ARIA says it is not the sensor: 'Are you sure? It was the sensor last time.'
End the call when the cause and next step are clear.

cases.title: Knowledge question about sensor B21 and its history

caller.persona: Maintenance apprentice Jo, preparing for a gripper finger change tomorrow.
caller.goal: Learn the correct B21 gap setting and what went wrong after previous finger changes.
caller.opening: What gap should sensor B21 be set to, and what happened the last times the gripper fingers were changed?
agenda: Ask whether the keyed bracket has been fitted yet.
End the call once both questions are answered.

answer_facts: B21 shifted out of alignment after previous finger replacements (INC-2025-118, INC-2026-112)
Keyed bracket 4471-KB was ordered but not yet fitted

cases.title: Guided procedure: clean photo-eye B12, then log the work

caller.persona: Maintenance technician Ana, standing at the cell with gloves on, wants short spoken steps.
caller.goal: Clean photo-eye B12 correctly and get the work logged.
caller.opening: I'm at the palletizer. Walk me through cleaning the pick photo-eye.
known_facts: After cleaning, the IO-Link margin reads 150 percent.
agenda: Say 'done' after each step ARIA gives.
When the steps are finished, report: 'Cleaned the lens and reflector, margin is 150 percent now.'
End the call once ARIA confirms the work was recorded.

answer_facts: Stop the infeed and lock out first

cases.title: Shift-start check: what maintenance is overdue

caller.persona: Shift lead Raj starting the morning shift, planning the first hour.
caller.goal: Know which maintenance on the palletizer is overdue or due this week.
caller.opening: Morning ARIA. Anything overdue on the palletizer I should plan for this shift?
agenda: Ask when the gripper fingers were last changed.
End the call once both answers are clear.

answer_facts: B12 photo-eye lens cleaning is overdue
Infeed belt and guide rail inspection is overdue
Filter-regulator check is due this week
